name: OpenAI Codex CLI (codex exec)
sandbox_writable_roots: per thread, from `git rev-parse --git-dir --git-common-dir`: the worktree root, the worktree's exact gitdir (.git/worktrees/<name>) and the common dir's objects/refs/logs. Lanes pass them in the thread/start config; `codex exec` appends them with --add-dir (a build without --add-dir gets a merged -c override that keeps the roots from ~/.codex/config.toml)
policy_switch: codex.worktree_gitdir_writable (default true): false keeps the sandbox's git metadata read-only
binary_resolution: newest candidate whose `codex features list` loads ~/.codex/config.toml (Homebrew 0.147 cannot)
plan_source: OPENSWARM_CODEX_PLAN env or policy codex.plan; opt-in: chatgpt_plan_type claim of ~/.codex/auth.json id_token (local_sources.codex_auth_plan, decoded locally, never sent)
quota_source: rate_limits lines in ~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl (local_sources.codex_sessions; per limit_id, primary/secondary windows)
sessionPolicy: keep (codex rollout retained; resumable with `codex exec resume <thread_id>`)
streaming_events: item.started command_execution is emitted BEFORE a command runs -> real-time RISK alerts
ops: after this ships, drop the hard-coded writable_roots hotfix from ~/.codex/config.toml on govpn/govpn2/box: a pinned worktree name goes stale as soon as a lane rebuilds its worktree
